DIAGNOSIS: Isolated idiopathic cervical dystonia (dystonic laterocollis and rotacollis; spasmodic torticollis)

Alternative: Primary generalized dystonia

Alternative: Genetic dystonia, including DYT1-associated dystonia

Alternative: Secondary cervical dystonia, including Wilson disease or drug-induced dystonia
